mostWorthwhile.text: Forming the iron core was most worthwhile: the density explanation connected the mythic combination to how a planet separates into layers.

leastWorthwhile.text: The failed attempt to combine the planetary disk with Gravity was a little confusing, although the automatic Earth combination kept it moving.
